description: READ ONLY. The current status of one of the person’s own letters by its Piloxa reference, once this chat is connected: printer acceptance, USPS acceptance, delivery or return, the return receipt, each with its source and when it was last checked, the reply-by date if the letter set one, and where to download the mailing record (signed in on piloxa.com). A missing USPS scan means unknown, not failed; delivered does not mean read; a passed reply-by date does not mean nobody answered. Ask the person whether a reply arrived before suggesting a follow-up.
name: get_my_letter
title: One of the person’s letters
